analyst_view.overall: Lyon are third and only three points behind PSG, but they played at Real Sociedad on Thursday in the Europa League (1-1), so they have had three days to recover. They are also without Lois Openda and Pavel Sulc. Brest are 10th and come in on two straight league wins, but they have won only one of four home games and are short of centre-backs with Brendan Chardonnet and Raphael Le Guen out.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Brest's thin defence argues for more goals, but Lyon's tired legs and missing forwards (Openda, Sulc) argue for fewer. Those roughly cancel out, so we stay close to the model.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. Brest like to play direct to Ludovic Ajorque, which tends to produce corners, and nothing in the news moves us away from the model.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards. Jeremy Stinat is the referee, and neither side has suspension or discipline issues in the news, so we have no reason to move.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.9 shots. With a Thursday away trip in their legs, Lyon may control the tempo rather than press, and without Openda and Sulc they have fewer attacking options. We lean slightly lower on the total.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.9 shots on target. Brest's recent scoring form (10 goals in their last six) offsets Lyon's weakened attack, so we stay with the model.
